description:

title:
Important Points·Devotees are welcome to stay for a minimum
of 2 nights and up to a maximum of 7 nights, allowing as many devotees as
possible to experience Swamiji’s presence.·Children below the age of 10 are not
permitted in the ashram during this event.Personal Meetings with Swamiji·Personal meetings with Swamiji will take
place on discourse days. Participants for these meetings will be selected
through a draw system conducted in the temple.
